original_analysis: Under fixed routing C belongs directly to G. Hypothetical P=480000 and M=960000 with delta4800 produce targets484800 and964800; wrong-domain distance is484800, not4800. Actual pause of G at482400 leaves2400ticks before the scheduled484800.
limits: C.parentclock refers to G own clock, not G.parentclock.
Child-only pause does not imply that parentclock freezes.
Readings are hypothetical conditions, not logs or an atomic query snapshot.
Tick distance is not a measured wall-clock or device latency.
No conversion algorithm, expired-target behavior, propagation guarantee or live rerouting claim.
Studio event timing and Core ChannelGroup behavior are not conflated.

deduplication.scope: Current complete music-transition reader, related local playback/fade/callback readers and prior gates, default-branch queries parentclock/getDSPClock/setDelay without matches. Not exhaustive whole-history semantic proof.
